name: ASEC Company for Mining ASCOM, S.A.E

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: the same company (aseccompanyforminingascomsae) is served under two keys, ASCM PE 9.14 and EGS10001C013.CA PE 1.46, and they disagree; one market capitalisation cannot be two, so neither multiple is verified. Every market-based multiple of this security is built on that market cap, so none of them is a valuation. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.peCrossCheck: differ by 14%: market cap 2530000000 used (price x shares) vs 2926000000 on file
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2025 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: current price / book value per share, where book value per share = total equity / shares outstanding
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 5e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.psFormula: current price / revenue per share, where revenue per share = revenue / shares outstanding
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 5e+07 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_EGX.json)
valuation.peg_withheld_reason: Withheld: a compound growth rate of earnings is not defined from the periods on file: it needs net profit POSITIVE in BOTH endpoint years (FY2021 and FY2025), and one of them is not. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.

flags.label: Persistently weak cash conversion
flags.detail: Operating cash flow has been under 80% of net profit for 2 straight periods (latest 0.28x).

derived.ytdBasis: year to date from the last close before 2026 (2025-12-31, 43.39) to the price on 2026-10-05
